name: workflow-toolbox
description: Toolbox for Claude Code's Workflow tool — author deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (workflow-composer, with the @workflow-toolbox compile-time pattern toolkit as its standard library), scaffold a build-clean workflow skeleton from a spec (toolkit-scaffold), diagnose a failed run from its journal and decide whether resumeFromRunId helps (workflow-debugger), re-verify the runtime surface after a Claude Code upgrade (upgrade-canary). Ships a Stop hook that auto-surfaces a finished Workflow run's cost + traceability audit report (always a notice; grabs the session only when the run looks like trouble).
